name: Confirm Destructive Operations
description: Requires confirmation for destructive operations like DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE, database migrations, and mass file deletions
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Flag destructive operations for user confirmation
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
# Check for destructive SQL
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qiE '(DROP\s+(TABLE|DATABASE|INDEX|SCHEMA)|TRUNCATE|DELETE\s+FROM\s+\w+\s*$)'; then
  echo "WARNING: Destructive SQL operation detected: $COMMAND"
  echo "Please confirm this is intentional before proceeding."
  exit 2
fi
# Check for destructive file operations
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE 'find\s+.*-delete'; then
  echo "WARNING: Mass file deletion detected. Please confirm."
  exit 2
fi
exit 0
